PreToolUse.description: Block dangerous bash commands (allowlist-based: rm -rf /, rm -rf ~, sudo, secrets read)
Block unvalidated SKILL.md writes — requires a green eval record. The path filter lives inside skill_write_gate.py, which exits 0 for anything that is not a SKILL.md under skills/.
Block reading .env, secrets, credentials, and private key files

hooks.command: p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$p" in *.env|*.env.*|*/secrets/*|*/credentials*|*.pem|*id_rsa*|*id_ed25519*) echo "[ReadGuard] BLOCKING read of protected file: $p" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

Stop.description: Prevent Stop until all wave tasks are complete (wave barrier)
Bootstrap mission gate: block Stop until all 5 phases in .bootstrap-state.json are done and gate_passed (guarded by stop_hook_active to avoid infinite loops)

UserPromptSubmit.description: Reinject calibration rules C1, C2, C9, C12 on every message
